confirmedIssues.title: Alias lacks header range and can give list/report different defaults
confirmedIssues.mechanism: RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS has /notifications/inbox but not the equally mounted /notifications. Header-owned defaults use product preferences; alias page defaults7d but body passes product default.

repro.steps: Without URL/shared stored dates and with defaultAnalysisRange=30d, reason through /notifications: header range=false; page/report7d versus body30d. Canonical inbox makes both header-owned. No navigation performed.

confirmedIssues.fix: Register alias in existing workspaceScope owner, preserving vehicle=false, both bounds and shared semantics.

confirmedIssues.title: No-data paused/idle sources are described as empty or active loading
confirmedIssues.mechanism: isLoading is false for pending+paused/idle. Summary/list/member branches then claim no notifications/threads/members. Registries label every unresolved no-data state Loading, even paused; stale warning intentionally suppresses no-data notices.

repro.steps: Synthetic data=undefined,isPending=true,isLoading=false,fetchStatus=paused,error=null: evaluate false-empty summary/list/member branches and Loading Vehicles/Rules despite paused acquisition. Idle unresolved also becomes summary empty. NOT EXECUTED.

confirmedIssues.fix: Gate authoritative emptiness on resolved payload; use shared source state for initial-loading/paused/unknown/recovery, retaining shells and real empty arrays.

confirmedIssues.title: Members inherit thread-list offset and have no independent pager
confirmedIssues.mechanism: The paged thread filters are merged unchanged into the distinct member result set. Only one bounded member array is mapped; there is no member pager/load-more. Removing latest from fetched members does not make them complete.

repro.steps: Reason from thread page2,size50 and a3-member thread: member request carries offset50, potentially returning no siblings. On page1 a >50-member thread has no route to older members. Backend result illustrative, not queried; forwarding/missing control source-confirmed.

confirmedIssues.fix: Separate typed member pagination from thread offset; retain both bounds, filters, keys, cancellation and complete reachability. Verify backend capability before choosing pagination strategy.

confirmedIssues.title: Raw member error removes cached siblings and offers no Retry

evidence.quote: it('shows an inline error when fetching members fails', async () => {

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Any raw error gates all member rows. The role=alert branch is text only; refetch is not retained/exposed. Failed refresh is therefore treated as fatal despite usable siblings.

repro.steps: Retained [latest,sibling] plus error=Error(refresh failed),isLoading=false: otherMembers contains sibling, but !membersError fails and no Retry callback appears. Source scenario, not mounted.

confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing useDataState/feedback, retain siblings on refresh failure, and expose per-member-source retry/provenance.

confirmedIssues.title: Fatal initial count removes navigation without independent recovery

evidence.quote: {countState.fatalError && <Text variant="bodySm">{t('notifications.inbox.countError', 'Could not load the notification count: {{error}}', { error: String(countState.fatalError) })}</Text>}

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Both pagers depend on countData. Fatal count is Text only and does not wire countState.retry/refetch. PullToRefresh refreshes only list/groups. Rows remain, but multi-page results can be stranded.

repro.steps: List resolves50rows while count rejects before any total is retained: total-unavailable label, no next/page-size controls and no count Retry. No request made.

confirmedIssues.fix: Expose count-specific Retry and honest unknown-total paging/recovery, without inventing a denominator or removing evidence.

confirmedIssues.title: Current rule severity overwrites persisted evidence; missing severity becomes info
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Grouped rows prefer current mutable rule metadata over persisted event severity. Without either source they fabricate info, whereas flat/details preserve log severity/unknown.

repro.steps: Persisted critical log and later rule severity=info: grouped says info, flat says Critical. No-rule missing severity grouped also says info. Branch reasoning only.

confirmedIssues.fix: Keep persisted severity authoritative, distinguish current rule context, preserve aliases and render missing/unknown neutrally without changing raw data.

confirmedIssues.title: Unresolved detail is synthesized as Open with an Acknowledge action
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Missing acknowledgement evidence becomes null in the synthetic summary. detail??alert is treated as known unacknowledged, showing Open/Awaiting acknowledgement and enabled primary action; audit loading/error does not gate it.

repro.steps: Synthetic rule log with detail undefined and pending/paused/fatal query: ack=null,isAcknowledged=false,Open,Acknowledge. No drawer/action invoked.

confirmedIssues.fix: Retain summary but show unknown lifecycle/owner and gate lifecycle writes until authoritative allowed state/pending status is available.

confirmedIssues.title: Row vehicle timestamps use the globally selected vehicle timezone
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Row vehicle merely selects mode; DateTime has no row identity prop and useTimezone reads global selection. Notifications hide global picker, but retained selection can differ from the displayed vehicle.

repro.steps: RowA zone America/Los_Angeles, selectedB Europe/Berlin (or none/user override): grouped timestamp resolves B/user zone while row names A. Source reasoning; no settings changes.

confirmedIssues.fix: Use/disclose intended inbox zone consistently or supply actual row timezone through supported existing formatter boundary, not substituted global identity.

confirmedIssues.title: Summary/drawer dates bypass saved context; relative text remains English

evidence.quote: const lastReceivedValue = stats.lastTs > 0 ? formatRelativeTime(new Date(stats.lastTs)) : null;
const lastReceivedSubtitle = stats.lastTs > 0 ? formatDateTime(new Date(stats.lastTs)) : undefined;

confirmedIssues.mechanism: No locale/timezone options passed: absolute dates use browser defaults rather than saved context used by flat DateTime in=user. Shared formatRelativeTime emits English Just now/m ago/h ago.

repro.steps: Saved hypothetical de-DE/UTC and browser en-US/Los_Angeles: five-minute summary remains5m ago; absolute summary/drawer differs from user-mode flat UTC timestamp. No settings modified.

confirmedIssues.fix: Reuse preference-aware displays. Existing shared date helper owner phase6-fix-relative-future-dates remains exclusive; no duplicate helper rewrite.

confirmedIssues.title: Multi-ID filters display only first vehicle/rule
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Body/hook retain and send all CSV array IDs. Selects/chips describe only index0, concealing active members in grouped/mobile and desktop source filters.

repro.steps: URL vehicle_id=1,2&rule_id=10,20: requests retain both pairs; controls/chips show only1/10. Not navigated/queried.

confirmedIssues.fix: Disclose all IDs or truthful multi summary; retain single-choice change behavior and unknown #ID fallbacks, never discard URL members.

confirmedIssues.title: Grouped heading mixes full thread total with unlabeled loaded-page membership
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Count hook removes pagination; countData.total is all matching threads, but membership sum uses only loaded groups. Adjacent text never labels the second quantity loaded/sample.

repro.steps: 100 matching threads,50 loaded groups count3 each yields100threads Ã‚Â·150notifications, though150 only covers loaded page. Illustrative source calculation, not data query.

confirmedIssues.fix: Label loaded-page membership explicitly; preserve real total and member-ID selection. Do not invent full member totals.

confirmedIssues.title: Report bars bypass saved chart palette

evidence.quote: <Bar dataKey="triggered" name={t('notifications.report.triggered', 'Triggers recorded')} fill="#22d3ee" hide={hiddenSeries?.isHidden('triggered') ?? false} />

confirmedIssues.mechanism: Series fills are constants despite canonical frame/hiddenSeries use; selected palette does not reach these props.

repro.steps: Any selected palette with different first two colors leaves both fixed fill props unchanged. No render/preference action; not measured contrast.

confirmedIssues.fix: Use current chart palette/tokens; preserve both series IDs, buckets, hiddenSeries, data alternative, export and chartKey.

confirmedIssues.title: Known grouped severity UI text bypasses i18n
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Known wire values info/warn/critical render directly. Flat table already translates known severity labels. Unknown raw identifiers are an acceptable evidence fallback, not permission to skip known-label localization.

repro.steps: Known warn in non-English UI remains literal warn in grouped view while flat requests its existing translation key. Source comparison, not locale switch.

confirmedIssues.fix: Translate known severities through existing keys, preserving raw unknown values. Catalog changes parent-only.

confirmedIssues.title: Group unread count bypasses numeric preferences
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Raw React numeric text does not use selected number-format bridge, unlike summary metrics/report counts.

repro.steps: Hypothetical unread_count12345/de-DE emits12345 instead of locale grouping12.345. Source reasoning only.

confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing fmtInt/useNumberFormatting and maintain raw count/filter scope and accessible meaning.

message={t('notifications.group.emptyMessage', 'Related notifications are grouped here when they occur repeatedly.')}

repro.steps: Summary populated but q=no-match evidence resolves[]: No notifications plus events-appear-when-triggered copy, or generic No threads. No request made.

confirmedIssues.fix: Distinguish no records from no matches; retain shell and allow optional-filter reset without resetting workspace bounds.

confirmedIssues.title: Grouped chrome retains fixed white/cyan surfaces and focus ring
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Fixed white-alpha/cyan classes bypass current semantic surface/control/focus tokens and restrained theme decisions. Root archive link has already adopted shared chrome.

repro.steps: Source classes unchanged across light/dark/custom themes. Effective contrast/focus/visual intensity NOT measured; no native visual failure asserted.
